4. `--surface run-sheet` → `N4, R7, N9, P1.runsheet` green (the D-SPA.20-1 N9 arm plus the
   already-green siblings re-verified on this stage).
5. Reports + screenshots committed under `docs/build/reports/2026-10-29_n9/`.
6. `destroy` → zero-orphan sweep → `rm` at closeout; cost recorded.
7. Honest flips/notes on the D-rows; `nextTicket` stays `200_R6WATCH.1`.
